doc.title: Steve Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, December 15, 2017

title: Blindfold test: Joe Farnsworth on drums
summary: Rowe plays a live Rochester recording; Davis recognises drummer Joe Farnsworth and is surprised to hear himself.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Well do you recall the Down Beat blindfold tests?
You know I’m afraid it might be me.
You don’t have to be afraid.
Oh my God. Is that “All the Things You Are”?
You know it’s from the Rochester Jazz Festival.
Oh yeah. That’s Joe Farnsworth playing drums. Yeah. I was like the drummer’s killing. That’s Joe.

Well it’s not that great a recording because it was live, I mean quality-wise, but I wanted to play it for you because the older gentlemen that I’ve interviewed, the fellas that were playing back in the 30s and 40s, they always insisted that you have to find your own sound. They’d say, “Sweets Edison? One note you’d know.” And it’s important. So what makes Steve Davis’s trombone — © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
